text: {"assertions":["The off-by-one cent error in billing/invoice_totals.py was caused by a bare except clause that swallowed an error.","The bug manifested as a one-cent gap in reconciliation reports when totaling invoices with three prorated lines.","The off-by-one cent billing bug occurred specifically for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary.","The fix narrowed the exception handler in billing/invoice_totals.py and was submitted as PR #1257 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-1.","After the fix was applied, the reconciliation alert remained quiet for 62 consecutive days.","The billing reconciliation bug is covered by tests in tests/billing/test_invoice_totals.py."]}
